div.head: VI As Prolog
div.ab: Ðis is seo gerǽdnes þe þa biscopas ⁊ þa gerefan þe to Lundenbyrig hyrað gecweden habbað, ⁊ mid weddum gefæstnod on urum friðgegyldum, ægðer ge eorlisce ge ceorlisce, to ecan þam domum þe æt Gréatanléa ⁊ æt Exanceastre gesette wæron, ⁊ æt Þunresfelda.

These are the ordinances which have been agreed upon and confirmed with solemn declarations in our association, by the bishops and reeves who belong to London—both by nobles and commoners—as a supplement to the decrees which were promulgated at Grately, and Exeter, and at Thundersfield(?).

Hoc est constitutum (consultum) quod episcopi et prepositi, qui Londoniensi curie pertinent, edixerunt et iureiurando confirmauerunt in suo friðgildo, comites et uillani, adiectione iudiciorum que apud Greateleiam et Exoniam instituta sunt et item apud Þunresfeldam.
